verdict.rationale: Rootly publishes its own API reference at docs.rootly.com/api-reference, with API-key setup, an API changelog of dated endpoint changes, and a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec for exploring endpoints or generating clients. No evidence shows the reference is interactive, and the swagger.json URL returns 403 to non-browser clients while the standard docs OpenAPI paths return 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
